The following technical challenges need to be addressed: - The design of an air interface that allows measuring accurately signal characteristics at the receiver (such as timing, phase and directional of arrival) for remote sensing while maintaining a high spectral efficiency for communications, and full-duplex operation with a capability of continuous transmission and reception for remotesensing applications. - The complexity of transmitters and receivers that reach the required accuracy for remote sensing while minimising the impact on the communication link throughput, would require architectural design trade-off and techniques selection and verifications. - Definition of scenarios regarding available and future payload technologies (antenna, front-end and processing). Чрез интегрираната система всички данни от измерванията ще постъпват синхронизирано в обща база данни, с които в последствие в офисна среда се разработват хидрографски снимки в предварително избран формат и геодезическа система, диаграми, схеми и други документи за навигационни и други цели.
